description: Optimize RalphGPU for NVIDIA Blackwell architecture compatibility

stories.title: Analyze Blackwell per-thread execution model impact on RalphGPU
stories.completion_promise: Analysis document explaining required changes for per-thread tensor execution
stories.details: Blackwell replaces warp-synchronous MMA with tcgen05.mma single-thread instruction. Each thread independently issues MMA operations. Analyze how this affects RalphGPU's warp_scheduler.v and tensor_core.v. Key changes: 1) Per-thread vs warp-level scheduling, 2) Removal of warp-level synchronization for tensor ops, 3) Independent MMA dispatch.

stories.title: Design Tensor Memory (TMEM) integration for RalphGPU
stories.completion_promise: TMEM architecture design document with integration plan
stories.details: Blackwell introduces 256KB Tensor Memory per SM (128 rows x 512 columns of 32-bit cells). TMEM replaces register-based accumulator storage. Operands reside in shared memory and TMEM. Design TMEM module with: 1) 2D array structure (512 cols x 128 lanes), 2) 16 TB/s read / 8 TB/s write bandwidth, 3) tcgen05.alloc/dealloc/ld/st operations.

stories.title: Analyze Triton compilation path requirements for RalphGPU
stories.details: Triton compiles Python -> Triton-IR -> Triton-GPU IR -> LLVM-IR -> PTX. Analyze: 1) What PTX instructions Triton generates, 2) Which instructions RalphGPU already supports, 3) Gap analysis for missing opcodes. Focus on memory coalescing, shared memory patterns, and tensor core usage.

stories.title: Implement tcgen05 instruction decoder opcodes
stories.completion_promise: decoder.v updated with tcgen05.mma, tcgen05.ld, tcgen05.st, tcgen05.cp opcodes
stories.details: Add Blackwell tcgen05 instruction family to decoder.v: 1) tcgen05.mma - single-thread MMA operation, 2) tcgen05.ld/st - TMEM load/store, 3) tcgen05.cp - async tensor data transfers, 4) tcgen05.alloc/dealloc - TMEM allocation. Use new opcode range.

stories.title: Implement Tensor Memory module
stories.details: Create rtl/tensor_memory.v implementing: 1) 256KB storage (512 cols x 128 rows x 32-bit), 2) Row/column address encoding (16 MSB row, 16 LSB col), 3) tcgen05.alloc column allocation tracking, 4) High-bandwidth read/write ports, 5) Integration hooks for SM.

stories.title: Implement asynchronous MMA dispatch in tensor_core.v
stories.completion_promise: tensor_core.v updated with async per-thread MMA support
stories.details: Modify tensor_core.v for Blackwell-style async MMA: 1) Remove warp-synchronous requirement, 2) Add per-thread MMA issue, 3) Connect TMEM for accumulator storage, 4) Add mbarrier synchronization for TMA/MMA/epilogue coordination, 5) Support tcgen05.commit for completion signaling.

stories.title: Update blackwell_scheduler.v for per-thread tensor scheduling
stories.completion_promise: blackwell_scheduler.v updated for finer-grained tensor op scheduling
stories.details: Enhance blackwell_scheduler.v: 1) Add per-thread tensor op tracking, 2) Reduce synchronization overhead for MMA, 3) Enable independent compute/tensor/memory pipeline scheduling, 4) Update scoreboard for async MMA operations.

stories.title: Create tcgen05 instruction testbench
stories.completion_promise: tb/tb_tcgen05.v testbench passes all tcgen05 operations
stories.details: Create testbench for tcgen05 instructions: 1) Test tcgen05.alloc/dealloc lifecycle, 2) Test tcgen05.ld/st to TMEM, 3) Test tcgen05.mma with SMEM operands, 4) Verify async completion with mbarrier.

stories.title: Verify backward compatibility with existing tests
stories.completion_promise: All existing PTX tests still pass after Blackwell changes
stories.details: Run full test suite to ensure backward compatibility: 1) Run make test to verify all existing tests pass, 2) Check warp-synchronous WMMA still works, 3) Verify traditional warp scheduling not broken, 4) Confirm shared memory operations unchanged.

stories.title: Test with Triton-generated PTX sample kernel
stories.completion_promise: Sample Triton kernel PTX compiles and runs on RalphGPU
stories.details: Create a simple Triton kernel (e.g., vector add or GEMM), compile to PTX, and run on RalphGPU: 1) Write simple Triton kernel, 2) Compile to PTX, 3) Assemble to RalphGPU hex, 4) Run and verify output.
